decision: Selected the centroid of the union of Rowan Cinco Subdivision Lots 1R, 3, 4 and 5 in Medina County (owner Rowan Land Resources LLC; 425.832 geodesic acres in three parts) as the campus locator for Rowan's Project Cinco. The two groups do not touch: their nearest edges are 15.9 m apart (UTM 14N), across County Road 683, and their centroids are 1565.3 m apart. Rowan Cinco Subdivision Lot 2 (8.519 geodesic acres) is owned by AEP Texas Inc and adjoins Lot 1R; it is excluded from the Rowan-owned union. The Coal Mine subdivision (57 small residential lots, owners not restated) lies immediately east of the Rowan Lytle LLC parcels, centred about (-98.81347, 29.22663). No parcel in the sweep is owned by Microsoft, Amazon, Google, Meta or another data-centre-named entity.
